messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P95/P99 latency spike detected for /v1/chat/stream. Alerting on-call.
Alex: I’m on it. seeing p95 ~2.3s (baseline ~350ms) and p99 ~7.9s. Streaming stalls reported by a few customers. Correlating with increased preprocessing CPU on model-proxy-*.logs
Maria: Any deployment around the time window? deploy-bot, did anything go out ~10:00 UTC? 
deploy-bot: rollout: redwood/chat-1.2.3 -> canary (10%) @ 1767903900
Santhosh: noted. I’m pulling traces. Initial look: a bunch of requests show long time in 'prompt_build' span, not the model inference span. 
Emma: customers reporting stalls in streaming UI, chunks arriving late. We need mitigation if it’s pre-inference.
Chao: attaching quick tail sample:
```
span: prompt_build duration=1210ms tags={template_engine=v2, tokenizer=tokenize_v1}
span: model_generate duration=180ms
```
Alex: wow prompt_build 1.2s for some requests. That explains p99. Is tokenizer being called multiple times per request? 
Santhosh: grep logs:
```
for req in requests:
  tokens = tokenizer.encode(prompt)  # called inside preprocessor for tool schemas
  prompt_final = render_template(schema, tools, tokens)
```
We’re seeing repeated encode calls per tool and heavy regex in template rendering. 
Maria: how many tokens typical? these are medium length prompts (800-1200 chars) -> ~180-300 tokens. tokenizer encode should be ~5-10ms. Not 1s.
Chao: env shows template_engine=v2 flagged on canary only. Looks like v2 uses per-tool tokenization + schema validation JSON checks. That could multiply cost by number of tools.
Alex: immediate mitigation options:
 - rollback canary to v1
 - flip feature flag to disable template v2
 - add bypass: use pre-tokenized cache for repeated prompts
 - throttle incoming rate for affected route
Emma: rollback is fastest. Can we flip canary to 0% for chat-1.2.3? deploy-bot, canary -> 0?
deploy-bot: Received: rollback canary -> 0% starting now
Santhosh: rolling back now. I’ll also push a hotfix to short-circuit tokenizer when JSON-mode is requested (saves one encode). Patching a config in model-proxy to prefer fast_json_mode.
Product-Eng: customer impact: which customers impacted? any SLA breaches? need list to notify CS.
Alex: queued errors show ~42 customer sessions affected in last 15m; errors = streaming stalls/timeouts but not complete 5xxs. We likely missed p95 SLO (200ms target for prompt build+inference). This is a partial SLO breach for chat streaming route.
Chao: after rollback stats: p95 dropped to ~420ms, p99 ~1.1s within 5 minutes. Good sign. 
Emma: still seeing a small tail at ~1.1s—probably cold cache. Santhosh, hold hotfix deploy but run canary for that small patch in 5% initially.
Santhosh: starting hotfix canary for tokenizer short-circuit @ 1767904180
Alex: quick mitigation notes for responders:
 - If customers call, tell them we had a template engine regression in a canary deploy causing repeated tokenization and template schema validation; rollback completed; partial SLO breach recorded; on-call will monitor.
 - Incident severity: Sev 2 until p99 < 1s for 30m.
Maria: creating incident page, adding affected customer list and timeline.
Product-Eng: please include whether any prompt changes or new tool schemas were introduced by product teams recently.
Emma: handoff: I need to step out in 10. Alex, can you take next hour? oncall-bot please mark this as acknowledged by Alex.
oncall-bot: Acknowledged. On-call handover: Alex -> Santhosh after 1 hour.
Alex: will do. Current action items:
 - Monitor p95/p99 for next 30m (Alex)
 - Verify hotfix canary metrics and errors (Santhosh)
 - Compile customer impact list and notify CS (Maria)
 - Add regression test for per-request tokenization in CI (Chao)
Santhosh: hotfix canary metrics: tokenization median dropped from 350ms -> 8ms in canary pods. No new errors observed in canary traffic slice.
Alex: promoting hotfix to 50% then 100% once stable. 
deploy-bot: promote canary -> 50% @ 1767904285
deploy-bot: promote canary -> 100% @ 1767904300
Chao: added quick CI lint to detect double-encode patterns and heavy regex in template rendering. Also added a lightweight perf test to CI that measures tokenizer.encode latency on sample prompts.
Maria: customer impact summary (short): ~42 sessions affected across 7 customers, transient streaming stalls, no data loss, degraded latency p95/p99 for ~12 minutes. CS notified and drafting templated message.
Alex: closing incident thread after one more observation window. If p99 remains <1s for 30m, mark resolved and file postmortem. 
Santhosh: collecting traces and will attach short postmortem outline to incidents repo.
Emma: thanks everyone. quick note for PMs: avoid adding heavy per-tool schema validation inside render loop; prefer precompiled validators and pre-tokenize where possible.
Product-Eng: acknowledged. Will schedule follow-up with DX to validate template ergonomics.
Alex: handing off to Santhosh at 1767904321. Santhosh, you have the bridge and actions.
Santhosh: taking over. I’ll update the incident doc and start a postmortem draft. ":thumbsup:""
